-- library/library.go --
package library

import ("strings";"reflect")

var Counter = 100
var Shared = &Schema{Fields: []string{"name"}, Index: map[string]int{"name":0}}
type Schema struct { Fields []string; Index map[string]int }
type Record struct {
 Schema *Schema
 Text string
 Bytes []byte
 Map map[string]*Record
 Values []any
 Next *Record
 Fn func() *Record
}
func (s *Schema) NewRecord(name string) *Record {
 if Counter < 101 || s.Index["name"] != 0 { panic("constructor lost host state") }
 typ:=reflect.StructOf([]reflect.StructField{{Name:"Value",Type:reflect.TypeFor[string](),Tag:reflect.StructTag(strings.Clone(`json:"value"`))}})
 field:=typ.Field(0)
 if field.Name!="Value"||string(field.Tag)!=`json:"value"`{panic("constructor metadata copy failed")}

 r:=&Record{Schema:s,Text:strings.Clone(name),Bytes:make([]byte,1024)}
 r.Map=map[string]*Record{"self":r}
 r.Values=[]any{r.Text,r.Bytes,r}
 r.Next=r
 r.Fn=func()*Record{return r}
 return r
}
-- bindings/bindings.go --
package bindings

import (
 "errors"
 "reflect"
 "isolate"
 "strings"
 "sync"
 "example.org/hostintegration/library"
)

type Input struct { Name string; Callback func() }
var mu sync.Mutex
var saved isolate.HostContext
var prepared *library.Record
var scratch isolate.Allocator
var cache = map[string]*library.Schema{}
var SharedError = errors.New("shared error")

// Binding cells are host state. The compiler permits importing precisely a
// registered callable, without allowing reads of this package's other state.
var Lookup = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext, in Input)(*library.Record,error){
 mu.Lock()
 schema:=cache[in.Name]
 if schema==nil {schema=library.Shared;cache[strings.Clone(in.Name)]=schema}
 library.Counter++
 mu.Unlock()
 if in.Callback!=nil {c.Reenter(in.Callback)}
 return isolate.Allocate(c.Allocator(),func()*library.Record{return schema.NewRecord(in.Name)})
})
var Async = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,in Input)(*library.Record,error){
 w,a:=isolate.NewWaiter(),c.Allocator()
 name:=strings.Clone(in.Name)
 var result *library.Record
 var err error
 go func(){
  result,err=isolate.Allocate(a,func()*library.Record{return library.Shared.NewRecord(name)})
  w.Wake()
 }()
 w.Park()
 return result,err
})
var Nested = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext, fn func())(int,error){
 c.Reenter(fn)
 return 3,nil
})
var Metadata = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,_ int)(*library.Schema,error){return library.Shared,nil})
var Save = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,_ int)(int,error){saved=c;return 1,nil})
var Expired = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,_ int)(int,error){saved.Reenter(func(){});return 1,nil})
var Error = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,shared bool)(int,error){
 if shared {return 0,SharedError}
 err,e:=isolate.Allocate(c.Allocator(),func()error{return errors.New("caller error")})
 if e!=nil{return 0,e};return 0,err
})
var Mutate = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,p *int)(int,error){*p++;return *p,nil})
var Scratch = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,in Input)(*library.Record,error){
 scratch=c.Allocator()
 if in.Callback!=nil{c.Reenter(in.Callback)}
 return isolate.Allocate(scratch,func()*library.Record{return library.Shared.NewRecord("scratch")})
})
func ScratchExpired() bool {
 ran:=false
 _,err:=isolate.Allocate(scratch,func()int{ran=true;return 1})
 return err==isolate.ErrRevoked&&!ran
}
func PreexistingDenied(a isolate.Allocator)(denied bool){
 defer func(){denied=recover()!=nil}()
 _,_=isolate.Allocate(a,func()byte{return prepared.Bytes[0]})
 return false
}
var Reflected = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext, fn func())(int,error){reflect.ValueOf(fn).Call(nil);return 1,nil})
var Direct = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext, fn func())(int,error){fn();return 1,nil})
var ConstructCallback = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext, fn func()int)(int,error){return isolate.Allocate(c.Allocator(),fn)})
var Ordinary = func()(int,error){return 1,nil}
var Panic = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,_ int)(int,error){panic(library.Shared)})
var Prepared = isolate.NewHostFunc(func(c isolate.HostContext,_ int)(*library.Record,error){value:=prepared;prepared=nil;return value,nil})
func ClearPrepared(){prepared=nil}
func Prepare(a isolate.Allocator) error {
 var err error
 prepared,err=isolate.Allocate(a,func()*library.Record{return library.Shared.NewRecord("prepared")})
 return err
}
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import (
 "isolate"
 "runtime"
 "strings"
 "example.org/hostintegration/bindings"
)
var Counter=7
func Bump(){Counter++}
func Work(mode string)(string,error){
 if strings.HasPrefix(mode,"readonly") {
  go func(){
   _,_=isolate.ReadOnlyCall(3,nil)
   switch mode {
   case "readonly-write":_,_=bindings.Mutate(&Counter)
   case "readonly-callback":_,_=bindings.Scratch(bindings.Input{Callback:func(){Counter++}})
   default:
    r,err:=bindings.Scratch(bindings.Input{Callback:func(){if !isolate.IsReadOnly(){panic("lost query role")};_ = Counter}})
    if err!=nil{panic(err)};r.Bytes[0]=23
    isolate.Write(5,nil)
   }
  }()
  _,_=isolate.Call(4,nil)
  if Counter!=7{panic("query changed workflow state")}
  return "ok",nil
 }
 switch mode {
 case "reflected":_,err:=bindings.Reflected(Bump);return "bad",err
 case "direct":_,err:=bindings.Direct(func(){Counter++});return "bad",err
 case "direct-static":_,err:=bindings.Direct(Bump);return "bad",err
 case "constructor-callback":_,err:=bindings.ConstructCallback(func()int{Counter++;return Counter});return "bad",err
 case "opaque":
  schema,err:=bindings.Metadata(0);if err!=nil{return "",err};return schema.Fields[0],nil
 case "ordinary": _,err:=bindings.Ordinary();return "bad",err
 case "panic": _,err:=bindings.Panic(0);return "bad",err
 case "expired": _,_=bindings.Save(0);_,err:=bindings.Expired(0);return "bad",err
 case "native-effect":_,err:=bindings.Nested(runtime.Breakpoint);return "bad",err
 case "effect":
  _,err:=bindings.Nested(func(){runtime.GC()});return "bad",err
 case "registration":
  isolate.NewHostFunc(func(isolate.HostContext,int)(int,error){return 1,nil});return "bad",nil
 }
 if Counter!=7 {panic("private state leaked")}
 result,err:=bindings.Lookup(bindings.Input{Name:strings.Repeat("customer",8),Callback:func(){
  if Counter!=7 {panic("callback did not restore private state")};Counter++
  n,e:=bindings.Nested(func(){if Counter!=8{panic("nested private state lost")};Counter++})
  if e!=nil||n!=3 {panic("nested result changed")}
 }})
 if err!=nil{return "",err}
 if Counter!=9||result.Map["self"]!=result||result.Next!=result||result.Fn()!=result||len(result.Values)!=3 {panic("constructor graph or state changed")}
 result.Bytes[0]=42
 // Constructing a private result has not granted access to its shared schema.
 again,e:=bindings.Async(bindings.Input{Name:"async"});if e!=nil{return "",e}
 again.Bytes[0]=24
 if again.Text!="async" {panic("asynchronous data changed")}
 _,e=bindings.Error(false);if e==nil||e.Error()!="caller error"{panic("private error changed")}
 _,e=bindings.Error(true);if e==nil{panic("shared error lost")}
 p,e:=bindings.Prepared(0);if e!=nil{return "",e};p.Bytes[0]=11
 if p.Text!="prepared"{panic("pre-start construction changed")}
 return "ok",nil
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "time"
 "isolate"
 "strings"
 "example.org/hostintegration/bindings"
 "example.org/hostintegration/jobs"
 "example.org/hostintegration/library"
)
func dispatch(h isolate.Handle){
 mode,err:=isolate.Call(1,nil);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 err=h.Invoke(func(v ...isolate.Value)error{*v[0].Pointer.(*string)=string(mode);return nil},func(v ...isolate.Value)error{
  _,err:=isolate.Call(2,[]byte(v[0].Value.(string)));return err
 })
 if err!=nil{panic(err)}
}
func run(mode string){
 h,ok:=isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Work);if !ok{panic("missing entry")}
 clock:=time.Unix(0,0)
 i,err:=isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program:h.ProgramWithHandle(dispatch),Deterministic:true,InitialTime:&clock,TimerOp:99});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 // The ordinary library's constructor runs against host globals before Start.
 library.Counter++
 if err:=bindings.Prepare(i.Allocator());err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if !bindings.PreexistingDenied(i.Allocator()){panic("allocator borrowed preexisting storage")}
 if err:=i.Start();err!=nil{panic(err)}
 select{case c:=<-i.Commands():c.Reply([]byte(mode),nil);case <-i.Done():panic(i.Wait())}
 if strings.HasPrefix(mode,"readonly") {
  first,second:=<-i.Commands(),<-i.Commands()
  if first.Op!=3{first,second=second,first}
  if first.Op!=3||second.Op!=4{panic("wrong query handshake")}
  if err:=i.Suspend();err!=nil{panic(err)}
  first.Reply(nil,nil)
  if err:=i.ResumeReadOnly();err!=nil{panic(err)}
  if mode=="readonly"{
   select{case <-i.Writes():case <-i.Done():panic(i.Wait())}
   if err:=i.Suspend();err!=nil{panic(err)}
   if !bindings.ScratchExpired(){panic("scratch allocator did not expire")}
   second.Reply(nil,nil)
   if err:=i.Resume();err!=nil{panic(err)}
  }
 }
 if mode=="normal"||mode=="readonly" {
  select{case c:=<-i.Commands():if string(c.Payload)!="ok"{panic("wrong output")};c.Reply(nil,nil);case <-i.Done():panic(i.Wait())}
 }
 err=i.Wait()
 bindings.ClearPrepared()
 switch mode {
 case "normal","readonly":if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 case "opaque","ordinary":var e *isolate.OwnershipError;if !errors.As(err,&e){panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v",mode,err))}
 case "effect","native-effect","reflected","direct","direct-static","constructor-callback":var e *isolate.EffectError;if !errors.As(err,&e){panic(err)}
 default:var e *isolate.PanicError;if !errors.As(err,&e){panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %v",mode,err))};if mode=="panic"&&strings.Contains(e.Message,"name"){panic("published host panic value")}
 }
}
func main(){
 for _,mode:=range []string{"normal","normal","readonly","readonly-write","readonly-callback","opaque","ordinary","panic","expired","effect","native-effect","reflected","direct","direct-static","constructor-callback","registration"}{run(mode)}
 if jobs.Counter!=7||library.Counter<110{panic("host state changed incorrectly")}
 fmt.Println("typed host integration passed")
}
